game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess

author: KPrisma
quote: This is how you do a remake. Nintendo really managed to capture everything that made the original so special while giving it a fresh look. The atmosphere, music, and sense of adventure are just incredible. I'm really hoping Majora's Mask and Twilight Princess get the same treatment. Especially Twilight Princess, which deserves a proper remake after so long.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: KPrisma
quote: Honestly, pretty disappointing after all these years. The graphics are amazing, but the gameplay feels slow and restrictive. The missions are boring, the story didn't really grab me, and 30 FPS on PS5 is just ridiculous. Feels like Rockstar spent more time making everything look realistic than making the game fun. Expected a lot more after waiting this long.
